verdict.rationale: Lambda's 1-Click Clusters let users launch 16 to 512 H100/B200 GPU clusters "instantly" with "no long-term commitments." The clusters use GPUDirect RDMA at up to 3200 Gb/s, and users reserve them self-serve from the Lambda Cloud console. Managed Slurm and Kubernetes with InfiniBand support get users to a first multi-node job in minutes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that cluster provisioning is truly instant and sales-free; documentation of any minimum reservation term behind the "Reserve" flow; documented API-driven cluster provisioning (the API evidence covers instances only).

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can provision a multi-node GPU cluster with fast interconnect for distributed training without a sales cycle
